name: How do interest rate fluctuations impact the waterfront property market?

mainEntity.name: How do interest rate fluctuations impact the waterfront property market?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interest rate fluctuations directly impact buyer affordability and, consequently, demand in the waterfront property market. Higher rates can increase borrowing costs, potentially reducing the pool of eligible buyers and slowing market activity. Conversely, lower rates often stimulate demand. Buyers should consider their pre-approval status and the current rate environment as a key preparation step, understanding that even small changes can affect their purchasing power and monthly payments.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interest rate changes affect buyer affordability and demand. Higher rates can slow the market, while lower rates can stimulate it, impacting purchasing power.
